description: The source defines separate mixed-integer routing formulations for postal delivery and waste collection, with travel length, working-time and battery constraints. Smart charging limits demand peaks at district and station levels; a clustering/routing heuristic addresses large cases. Two case studies assess the models. Their geographic identity, original inputs and executable release are unknown. These are service-routing models and do not establish an implemented municipal programme. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
